operationalRunbooks.title: Local Continuity Runbook
operationalRunbooks.purpose: Verify governance and repository state before implementing a selected roadmap task.
steps: Read governance/SESSION-CONTEXT.md.
Read the selected task directly from governance/roadmaps/ENTERPRISE-10-10-ROADMAP.md.
Inspect the latest archive under governance/execution/archive/ENTERPRISE-10-10-V1/.
Verify root governance git status.
Verify each independent product repository git status.
Confirm that the selected task is the next eligible task.
Stop with STOP HUMAN REQUIRED if uncommitted changes or unexpected task closures are found.

operationalRunbooks.title: Product Impact Runbook
operationalRunbooks.purpose: Guide product changes only when the roadmap names a product repository.
steps: Confirm the impacted product repository from the roadmap.
Read existing validators and coverage files in that repository.
Implement real product artifacts for the selected task only.
Run existing relevant validators.
Run git diff --check before committing product changes.
Create a product commit only in the impacted product repository.
Record the product commit in governance evidence.

operationalRunbooks.title: Governance Closure Runbook
operationalRunbooks.purpose: Close the selected task with roadmap, current execution and archive evidence.
steps: Update the roadmap state for the selected task only.
Update governance/SESSION-CONTEXT.md.
Update governance/execution/current/.
Create the selected task archive.
Record validation commands, product commit, governance commit and push status.
Leave the next eligible task unopened.
Confirm future tasks and later workstreams remain untouched.

operationalRunbooks.title: Engram Continuity Runbook
operationalRunbooks.purpose: Use Engram as auxiliary memory while preserving git/governance as source of truth.
steps: Use project ai-native.
Query Engram before editing when a resume requests it.
Compare Engram output against git, roadmap, session context and archive.
Treat git/governance as the source of truth.
Record Engram failures as CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING when local governance is valid.
Do not reconstruct task scope from Engram alone.

operationalRunbooks.title: Push-Blocked Runbook
operationalRunbooks.purpose: Record blocked push attempts without rewriting local valid commits.
steps: Attempt push once for each affected repository.
Do not force push.
Do not change remotes without human authorization.
Do not retry in a loop.
Record CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING in governance evidence.
Preserve local commits as valid source of truth.
Save a push-attempt checkpoint in Engram when possible.

governancePlaybooks.title: Next Task Selection Playbook
rules: Select the next task only from the roadmap.
Do not infer scope from workstream name, prior chat history or Engram memory.
Confirm all prior tasks in the sequence are closed.
Confirm future tasks have not been closed unexpectedly.

governancePlaybooks.title: Documentation-Only Playbook
rules: Add meaningful governance documentation.
Add or update the machine-readable contract requested by the task.
Validate JSON artifacts when present.
Do not create product changes just to force a product commit.
Record product commit as N/A.
Preserve explicit non-goals.

governancePlaybooks.title: Product Task Playbook
rules: Modify only the impacted product repository.
Prefer existing repository patterns and validators.
Update product coverage or traceability files when relevant.
Avoid VERSION changes unless explicitly authorized.
Commit product changes before governance closure.

governancePlaybooks.title: Evidence Playbook
rules: Name the selected task and exact title.
Record product impact and product commit or N/A.
Record governance artifacts.
Record validation commands and results.
Record push status.
Record next eligible task and future-task guardrails.

incidentProcedures.condition: Any root or product repository has uncommitted changes before task edits.
steps: Stop before editing.
Report STOP HUMAN REQUIRED.
Do not stage, revert or overwrite unrelated changes.

incidentProcedures.condition: Local commit differs from the checkpoint required for the resume.
steps: Stop before editing.
Report expected and actual commits.
Do not repair history without human authorization.

incidentProcedures.condition: A future task appears closed before the selected task finishes.
steps: Stop before editing or closing governance.
Report STOP HUMAN REQUIRED.
Do not rewrite roadmap history.
Fix recoverable issues within the selected task scope.
Re-run the failing validation.
Stop with STOP HUMAN REQUIRED if the failure is ambiguous, external or outside scope.

incidentProcedures.condition: Engram search or save fails due policy, risk review or unavailable memory.
steps: Record CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING.
Continue if git/governance sources are valid.
Do not revert local commits.

incidentProcedures.condition: Push is blocked by policy, credentials or remote verification.
steps: Record CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING.
Do not retry repeatedly.
Do not change remotes.
Keep local commits as the source of truth.
